answer.text: The NAV as on a Valuation Day immediately prior to the current Valuation Day

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.3, Opening Series NAV = NAV as on the prior Valuation Day (or drawdown amount for first Valuation Day). The Trap: Other definitions don't match. Cross-Exam Context: Used in iterative series-level NAV computation. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Verify opening NAV carry-forward between quarters — small errors compound.
